collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VII: KNOWLEDGE, CONSENT AND SHARED WORK (LCG-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)

Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: An apprentice learns nothing from talk but everything from watching: change the teaching, or ask them to try harder.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has explained net-mending to (friend) twelve times, and (friend) still cannot do it. But yesterday, (subject) noticed (friend) watching a fisher mend a net from across the beach, and then mending one perfectly. (subject) has always taught by talking. What should (subject) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) stops talking and starts showing: slowly, knot by knot, with (friend) watching. (friend) learns in a day. (subject) is astonished, and a little embarrassed, and from then on teaches every apprentice both ways.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) tells (friend) to listen more carefully. (friend) tries, and fails, and gets quieter and quieter. Then another apprentice simply shows (friend), and (friend) gets it at once. (subject) sees, and thinks about it for a long time.
